name: re-frame2-lint
description: Repo-root manifest for the JS lint gate ONLY (rf2-2rtt6.78). The CLJS build and test toolchain lives in implementation/package.json; nothing else belongs here. ESLint lints .cjs/.mjs/.js across implementation/, tools/, examples/, testbeds/, docs/ and scripts/, so its manifest sits at the root that owns all of them — the same place .clj-kondo/config.edn and .splint.edn sit for the Clojure trees.
